title: True Fantasy REBORN
description: Tons of new weapons and structures and a revamped end
body:
A fun little project i made with tons of new structures,weapons and enchants plus a revamped end fight.Theres so much new stuff i couldnt even do everything!

Theres also some ressource packs you gotta activate and a shaderpack.

I hope you enjoy!

(PS:I didnt add anything to gallery because i dont wanna spoiler anything!)
